title: Ibutho Elahlangatshezwa YiFlying Clay
intro: Esikhathini sangaphambi koMprofethi uMuhammad, umbusi onamandla waseYemen waqala umkhankaso wezempi ohlose ukubhubhisa indawo engcwele eMakkah. Lesi sitha sahola ibutho elikhulu elinezindlovu zempi, siqiniseka ngamandla azo kanye nenani lazo. Kodwa-ke, uhambo lwazo lwaluzophela ngokuzumayo njengoba zihlangana nokungenelela kwaphezulu okungalindelekile. Ungabona ukuthi obani ababebhekene nalolu daba olumangalisayo?
clues: Sahamba nebutho elikhulu nezindlovu zempi ezinamandla saya endlini engcwele
Sasihlose ukugumbuqela nokubhidliza indawo yokukhulekela eyakhiwe yizinceku zoMuntu Onomusa
Kwathunyelwa umhlambi wezinyoni ezincane kithi, zithwele amatshe obumba emilonyeni nasezinzipho zawo
Sahlangatshezwa umsindo owasijikijela ngamatshe, wasiguqula saba yizinsalela ezinyathelwe phansi
Ngangivela ezweni laseYemen futhi ngakhonzwa ngaphansi kombusi owayefuna ukuvakashela indawo engcwele engcwele.
Senziwe isibonelo salabo abanesibindi sokususa indlu engcwele ka-Allah
verse: Did He not make their plan into misguidance? (105:2-4)
